description: GTFS du réseau maritime de Martinique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Martinique Transport. Martinique maritime transport network in the Caribbean: - Maritime routes between Fort-de-France and Les Trois-Ilets - Maritime line between Fort-de-France and Case-Pilote. Coverage: Martinique Transport. The portal shows the English title as "GTFS of the Martinique maritime network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Martinique Transport. Its keywords include maritime, martinique, bateau, vedettes-tropicales. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
